content.thinking:
I'll need to write the full scene in one pass without checking back. Planning out the design: a vermilion torii gate with gold caps, a stone path leading to a small shrine with a gabled roof, stone and paper lanterns glowing, offerings like sake, rice, fruit and coins, shide paper strips, shimenawa rope, fox statues, steps, and surrounding grass and flowers.

I'm structuring the imports from the custom builder, math, texture, and toon kit modules, then thinking through how to construct the torii using box and cylinder helpers for the pillars and an extruded curved profile for the kasagi beam with upturned tips, plus the nuki beam and shimaki underneath. I also need to keep the color palette limited to a small set of flat painted colors shared across parts to stay within material constraints.

Now I'm laying out the scene geometry: placing the torii gate, shrine, lanterns, and fox statues along the z-axis path on a stone ground slab, making sure the torii pillars reach down to the floor level. I'm also working out whether to use lathe geometry for the stone lanterns, checking if it needs an explicit axis parameter like extrude does, and planning a hexagonal cylinder-based base for the toro lantern.

Writing toro lantern components...

I should rebuild the roof as two rotated thin boxes plus a ridge cylinder and barge boards rather than a solid gable shape. For decoration, I'm adding an offering table with a sake bottle, rice bowl, mochi stack, oranges, gold coin cylinders, incense, ema plaques on a rack, and a slatted wooden offering box, plus some subtle glowing elemental wisps kept low near the ground.

I'm also planning a small sakura-style tree with pink blossom clusters, grassy tufts and flowers scattered randomly, and sketching out typed helper functions for boxes, cylinders, and spheres to keep the part-building code concise.

Still writing helper functions...

Defining more paint textures...

Still shaping the torii geometry...

Adding hanging lanterns with cords, scaled spheres, and ring details near the torii nuki beam, plus planning stone lanterns at ground level with a reusable helper function for positioning them.

Adding the pyramid roof and finial...

Now I'm laying out the shrine structure itself: a stone platform with a wood floor, a boxy painted body with corner pillars, and recessed front doors with lattice detailing.

Working out the slanted roof geometry next, figuring the panel lengths, angles, and ridge/eave positions so the two roof halves meet correctly above the body.

Adding crossed finials at the ridge ends and eave trim strips in red and gold along the roof edges, relying on the painted scale texture instead of extra geometry for tiles. Now I'm placing three stone steps in front of the platform, sizing each box step and working out their heights and vertical centers against the platform's front edge.

I'm also positioning a saisen offering box, realizing the gap between the platform and the doors is too tight, so I'm moving it further out onto the approach path instead.

For the offerings themselves, I'm sketching small sanbo stands with sake bottles and rice bowls placed on either side of the platform floor near the body, plus a slightly larger table off to one side.

I'm also planning an ema rack with two posts and a crossbeam holding four small shrine plaques, and designing a pair of kitsune guardian statues on stone pedestals flanking the platform, with elongated bodies, pointed snouts, upright ears, and a curved tail with a red bib detail.

Still shaping the fox features...

For the fox positioning, I'm checking the pedestal height math lines up with the body placement. Now I'm planning the sakura tree with a tapered trunk sweep, blossom clusters as scaled pink balls with mottled cel-shading, and small flat pink boxes scattered as falling petals.

Adding bushes, grass tufts, and little flower stems with ball heads in white and purple, then placing the shimenawa rope as a catmull curve sagging between the torii pillars rather than conflicting with the nuki beam.

Adding tassels at the rope ends, then sketching a floating motif above the shrine: a glowing torus ring with orbiting octahedra gems, keeping the anemo spiral concept simple rather than using a full spiral sweep function.

I'm capping the flat color palette around 25 to stay well under the limit, and glow will wrap directly around Part meshes. For textures I'm planning SVGs: a lattice pattern for the door, a plaque shape with a swirl wind symbol for the ema, and a gold plaque design for the torii.

Writing SVG glyph strokes...

For geometry I'm defaulting planes to face +Z world space, which works since all my front-facing elements are oriented that way, and the ema only needs to render from the front. I'm finalizing the export as a default build function using a seeded rng, double-checking there are no unused variables and that rotation/scale types match the expected number arrays.

Now I'm setting up the lathe profile for the sake bottle, outlining points that run from the base axis outward and back to form a closed revolve shape, then composing the full scene with positioned elements and color paints via the cel/grain helpers before writing out the final file.

Next I'm placing the torii gate in black with red accents, then laying out a sequence of stepping-stone path slabs along the z-axis leading toward a saisen offering box, with slight random offsets for natural variation, and sizing the ground cylinder to fit everything.

Adding branch rods and blossom clusters with mottled pink balls for the sakura tree, then settling on stone paint for the fox pedestal and cream-stone body with a vermilion bib.
